# Beetrus — Bitrus Sariki

> Abuja, Nigeria based fullstack software engineer, SaaS founder, and recording
> artist (Afrosounds / R&B / Drill). Founder of TrueWeb Solutions.

## Who
Bitrus Sariki, known as Beetrus. Fullstack engineer and music artist based in
Abuja, Nigeria.

## Engineering
- Founder of TrueWeb Solutions (Nigerian web + software agency, CAC BN 3818821).
- Builder of the AI product network:
  - SupportAI — AI customer-support chatbot (https://supportai.com.ng)
  - ReplyAI — AI reply + meeting assistant (https://replyai.com.ng)
  - HarvestAI — AI lead generation (https://harvestai.com.ng)
  - Beetrus Studio — AI lyric-video + clip studio (https://beetrus-studio.vercel.app)
- Stack: Next.js, React, Node, TypeScript, Postgres/Mongo.

## Music
- Releases under the Beetrus name, including the TEN/TEN project.
- Genres: Afrosounds, R&B, Drill.
